items.title: The local-local structure diagram can be chosen with all three corners affine
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: Assuming the notation of the chapter's local-local-structure lemma for finite type morphisms (a point x over s with a geometrically unibranch target or quasi-finite source etc., resolved after an elementary etale base change to a finite cover Y' -> X' -> S' with integral fibres), the lemma adds clause (7): S', Y', X' can all be taken affine. The retained proof is written: once Y' is affine, X' is affine because pi : X' -> Y' is finite; choose affine neighbourhoods U' of s' in S' and V' of y' in h^{-1}(U'); the image W' = h(V') is an open neighbourhood of s' (Morphisms, lemma smooth-open); take an affine U'' inside W'; then h^{-1}(U'') cap V' = U'' x_{U'} V' is affine, the restricted smooth map has fibres that are nonempty opens of the geometrically integral fibres of Y' -> S' hence geometrically integral (normality plus connectedness from the parent lemma's construction), so replacing (S', Y') by (U'', h^{-1}(U'') cap V') arranges (7) while preserving (1)-(6). Retained author proof at lines 13532-13545.
